verdict.rationale: Brevo documents its own export of raw transactional event data, but only for the past 7 days and with no stated file format. It also documents syncing customer data to warehouses or over SFTP, though it is unclear whether that sync covers full outbound export. Nothing shows a complete account-wide export in open formats that supports leaving the platform. Missing for 10: full account export (contacts, campaigns, templates, automations, CRM data), documented open export formats, export history beyond 7 days, an offboarding or portability path, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Export raw data of all transactional events from the past 7 days.
Sync customer data across your warehouse, POS, ERP, and other systems with Brevo via direct connectors or secure SFTP
